optimized_sql:
WITH filtered_date_dim AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_moy = 11
)
SELECT dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id AS brand_id, item.i_brand AS brand, SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN filtered_date_dim dt ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dt.d_date_sk
JOIN item item ON ss.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
WHERE item.i_manufact_id = 816
GROUP BY dt.d_year, item.i_brand_id, item.i_brand
ORDER BY dt.d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
